elements.description:
Spend breakdown: AI spend by model, feature, user or team for a period – a ranked list with shares and the change on
the period before, a stacked bar per day, or a table – with picking a slice to filter.

properties.name: entries
properties.description: The period's spend, one entry per day and slice

properties.name: previous
properties.description: The period before's spend, for the change in words; null leaves the change out

properties.name: dimension
properties.description: What to split by. Changed by the switch unless a tc-dimension-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: dimensions
properties.description: The dimensions the switch offers, in order

properties.name: dimensionLabels
properties.description: The switch's words for each dimension

properties.name: period
properties.description: The period shown. Changed by the select unless a tc-period-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: periods
properties.default: [ { id: "month", label: "This month" }, { id: "30d", label: "Last 30 days" }, { id: "quarter", label: "This quarter" }, ]

properties.name: view
properties.description: Ranked bars, a stacked bar per day, or a table. Changed by the switch unless a tc-view-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: selected
properties.description: The picked slice's id, or null for all. Changed by picking unless a tc-slice-select listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: locale
properties.description: The language for numbers and dates, e.g. "en-GB"; by default the browser's

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-dimension-change
events.description: The dimension was switched ({ dimension }: SpendDimensionChange); cancelable – prevented, `dimension` stays as it was

events.name: tc-period-change
events.description: Another period was picked ({ period }: SpendPeriodChange); cancelable – prevented, `period` stays as it was

events.name: tc-view-change
events.description: The view was switched ({ view }: SpendViewChange); cancelable – prevented, `view` stays as it was

events.name: tc-slice-select
events.description: A slice was picked or cleared ({ dimension, id, selected }: SpendSliceSelect); cancelable – prevented, `selected` stays as it was

functions.name: spendSlices
functions.signature: spendSlices(entries: SpendEntry[], dimension: SpendDimension, previous: SpendEntry[] | null): SpendSlice[]
functions.description: Each slice's cost and share in `entries`, biggest first, with its cost in `previous` (null when it had none)

props.name: dimension
props.description: What to split by – controlled when given

props.name: defaultDimension
props.description: The dimension on mount when `dimension` isn't controlled

props.name: period
props.description: The period's id – controlled when given

props.name: defaultPeriod
props.description: The period on mount when `period` isn't controlled

props.name: onPeriodChange
props.description: Another period was picked: pass that period's entries

props.name: view
props.description: Ranked, daily or table – controlled when given

props.name: defaultView
props.description: The view on mount when `view` isn't controlled

props.name: selected
props.description: The picked slice's id, or null for all – controlled when given

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: The picked slice on mount when `selected` isn't controlled

props.name: onSliceSelect
props.description: A slice was picked, or the pick cleared (null)

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
